items.question: Who runs this website?
items.answer: This website is exclusively operated by PlaywithK. For further questions regarding this topic, please visit the 'Web Development' section.

items.question: What is the purpose of this website?
items.answer: PlaywithK.de exists to provide information about projects by and with PlaywithK, as well as to showcase new discoveries!

items.question: Is this website private or commercial?
items.answer: This website is operated as a private project and has no commercial purpose.

items.question: May I reuse content from this website?
items.answer: All content from PlaywithK.de may be freely reused as long as a link back to the website is provided.

items.question: How often is content updated?
items.answer: Information on this website may become outdated, as it is maintained in my free time. The exact date of the last update can be found at the bottom right of each page.

items.question: Can I contribute to your projects?
items.answer: If you are interested in collaborating, feel free to send a request through the contact form. However, I usually work on my projects independently.

items.question: Are cookies or tracking used?
items.answer: Information about the processing of personal data and the use of cookies can be found in the privacy policy.

items.question: What happened to PWK Entertainment?
items.answer: Unfortunately, PWK Entertainment has been discontinued. Further information can be found on the dedicated subpage.
